text: Hvaða orð vantar í málsháttinn „Morgunstund gefur … í mund“?
gloss: Which word is missing from the proverb 'The morning hour gives … in the mouth'? — Gold: „Morgunstund gefur gull í mund“, the Icelandic 'early bird' proverb.

text: Íslensku jólasveinarnir koma til byggða einn á dag, sá fyrsti 12. desember og sá síðasti á aðfangadag. Hversu margir eru þeir?
gloss: The Icelandic Yule Lads come to town one a day, the first on 12 December and the last on Christmas Eve. How many are there? — 13: 12 to 24 December inclusive is 13 days (Stekkjarstaur to Kertasníkir); 12 is the off-by-one trap.

text: Faðir Önnu heitir Jón Sigurðsson. Hvert er föðurnafn Önnu?
gloss: Anna's father is Jón Sigurðsson. What is Anna's patronymic? — Jónsdóttir: it is formed from the father's first name; Sigurðardóttir would make her the daughter of her grandfather.

text: Hvaða lofttegund taka grænar plöntur upp úr loftinu og nýta við ljóstillífun?
gloss: Which gas do green plants take from the air and use in photosynthesis? — Carbon dioxide; oxygen is what they release.

text: Bolludagur, sprengidagur og öskudagur eru þrír dagar í röð og öskudagur ber alltaf upp á miðvikudag. Á hvaða vikudegi er sprengidagur?
gloss: Bun Day, Bursting Day and Ash Wednesday are three days in a row, and Ash Day is always a Wednesday. Which weekday is Bursting Day? — Tuesday: it is the middle day, the day before Wednesday (Shrove Tuesday).

text: Bospórussund skiptir einni borg í tvennt, svo að hluti hennar er í Evrópu og hluti í Asíu. Hvaða borg er það?
gloss: The Bosphorus splits one city in two, partly in Europe and partly in Asia. Which city? — Istanbul.

text: Hvaða fugl getur flogið aftur á bak, enda sveimar hann við blóm og sýgur úr þeim blómasafa?
gloss: Which bird can fly backwards, hovering at flowers and sipping their nectar? — The hummingbird.

text: Hve margir leikmenn hvors liðs eru inni á vellinum í einu í handbolta, markvörður meðtalinn?
gloss: In handball, how many players per team are on court at once, goalkeeper included? — 7: six court players and a goalkeeper.

text: Hvaða mjólkurmatur kemur við sögu í Egils sögu og er nú seldur víða um heim undir íslensku heiti sínu?
gloss: Which dairy food appears in Egil's Saga and is now sold around the world under its Icelandic name? — Skyr; Egill is served skyr at Ármóður's farm.

text: Hvaða tónskáld var orðið nær heyrnarlaust þegar það samdi níundu sinfóníu sína?
gloss: Which composer was almost deaf when he wrote his Ninth Symphony? — Beethoven.

text: Bóndadagur er fyrsti dagur þorra. Fyrsti dagur hvaða mánaðar er konudagur?
gloss: Husband's Day is the first day of Þorri. Woman's Day is the first day of which month? — Góa, the old month after Þorri; Harpa begins on the First Day of Summer.

text: Hvaða bókstafur íslenska stafrófsins stendur aldrei fremst í íslensku orði?
gloss: Which letter of the Icelandic alphabet never begins an Icelandic word? — Ð: try words (þak, æður, ör) and only ð fails; it occurs only inside or at the end of words.

text: Þú ekur hringveginn frá Reykjavík og leggur af stað í norður. Að hvaða bæ af þessum kemurðu síðast?
gloss: You drive the Ring Road from Reykjavík, setting off north. Which of these towns do you reach last? — Vík: the order is Blönduós, Akureyri, Egilsstaðir, then round the south coast to Vík.

text: Vatn sýður við 100 °C við sjávarmál. Hvað verður um suðumarkið á tindi hás fjalls?
gloss: Water boils at 100 °C at sea level. What happens to the boiling point on a high mountain top? — It drops: air pressure is lower, which is why eggs cook slowly at altitude.

text: Hvert þessara dýra er ekki spendýr?
gloss: Which of these animals is not a mammal? — The penguin, a bird; the dolphin, bat and seal look less like mammals but are.

text: Dagur íslenskrar tungu, 16. nóvember, er haldinn á fæðingardegi hvaða skálds?
gloss: Icelandic Language Day, 16 November, is held on which poet's birthday? — Jónas Hallgrímsson, born 16 November 1807.

text: Hvaða þjóð reisti borgina Machu Picchu hátt uppi í Andesfjöllum?
gloss: Which people built Machu Picchu high in the Andes? — The Inca; the others are Mesoamerican civilisations.

text: Hver skapaði Latabæ og lék sjálfur íþróttaálfinn?
gloss: Who created LazyTown and played Sportacus himself? — Magnús Scheving; Stefán Karl played the villain Robbie Rotten.

text: Lið fær 3 stig fyrir sigur og 1 fyrir jafntefli. Það lék 10 leiki, vann 6 og tapaði 2. Hve mörg stig fékk það?
gloss: A team gets 3 points for a win and 1 for a draw. It played 10, won 6 and lost 2. How many points? — 20: the 2 remaining games were draws, 6×3 + 2×1; 18 forgets the draws.

text: Hver stofnaði Microsoft ásamt æskuvini sínum Paul Allen árið 1975?
gloss: Who founded Microsoft in 1975 with his childhood friend Paul Allen? — Bill Gates.

text: Amma er hálfníræð í dag. Hvað er hún gömul?
gloss: Grandma is 'half-ninety' today. How old is she? — 85: 'hálfníræð' means halfway through the decade towards ninety; 45 is the trap of halving 90.

text: Orðið „tölva“ var myndað úr orðinu „tala“ og gömlu orði. Hvað merkir það orð?
gloss: The word 'tölva' (computer) was formed from 'tala' (number) and an old word. What does that word mean? — Seeress: Sigurður Nordal blended 'tala' and 'völva', a prophetess.

text: Hvaða faraó var grafinn í gröfinni sem Howard Carter fann nær óhreyfða árið 1922?
gloss: Which pharaoh was buried in the tomb Howard Carter found almost intact in 1922? — Tutankhamun.

text: Hvert var eina landspendýrið á Íslandi þegar landnámsmenn komu?
gloss: What was the only land mammal in Iceland when the settlers arrived? — The Arctic fox; reindeer were brought in the 18th century and mink in the 20th.

text: Þú sérð eldingu og heyrir þrumuna 6 sekúndum síðar. Hljóð fer um 340 metra á sekúndu. Hve langt er í eldinguna?
gloss: You see lightning and hear the thunder 6 seconds later. Sound travels about 340 m a second. How far away is it? — About 2 km: 6 × 340 = 2,040 m.

text: Hvert þessara Suður-Ameríkuríkja á ekki land að sjó?
gloss: Which of these South American countries has no coastline? — Paraguay; its similar-sounding neighbour Uruguay is on the Atlantic.

text: Tölvur reikna í tvíundakerfi, þar sem einu tölustafirnir eru 0 og 1. Hvaða tölu táknar runan 101 í því kerfi?
gloss: Computers work in binary, with only the digits 0 and 1. What number does 101 stand for in binary? — 5: one 4, no 2, one 1.

text: Hver samdi lagið við þjóðsönginn „Ó, guð vors lands“?
gloss: Who composed the music of the national anthem 'Ó, guð vors lands'? — Sveinbjörn Sveinbjörnsson (1874); Matthías Jochumsson wrote the words.

text: Sleipnir, áttfættur hestur Óðins, átti óvenjulega móður. Hver var hún?
gloss: Sleipnir, Odin's eight-legged horse, had an unusual mother. Who? — Loki, who turned into a mare (Snorra Edda); Gná is the goddess with the flying horse Hófvarpnir.

text: LEGO dregur nafn sitt af orðunum „leg godt“, „leiktu vel“. Frá hvaða landi er fyrirtækið?
gloss: LEGO takes its name from 'leg godt', 'play well'. Which country is the company from? — Denmark: the spelling is Danish (Norwegian would be 'lek godt').

text: Hvaða arkitekt teiknaði bæði Hallgrímskirkju og Þjóðleikhúsið?
gloss: Which architect designed both Hallgrímskirkja and the National Theatre? — Guðjón Samúelsson, State Architect.

text: Í fornum lögum og máldögum merkir „hundrað“ yfirleitt stórt hundrað. Hve mörg eru í því?
gloss: In old laws and church inventories, 'hundrað' usually means a 'great hundred'. How many is that? — 120: ten dozens (tólfrætt hundrað).

text: Í Íslandsklukku Halldórs Laxness er bóndi dæmdur fyrir að stela snæri. Hvað heitir hann?
gloss: In Laxness's Iceland's Bell, a farmer is sentenced for stealing a piece of rope. What is his name? — Jón Hreggviðsson; Bjartur and Ólafur Kárason are heroes of other Laxness novels.

text: Hvaða lofttegund er langmest af í andrúmslofti jarðar?
gloss: Which gas makes up by far the most of Earth's atmosphere? — Nitrogen, about 78%; oxygen is about 21%.

text: Á Íslandi er klukkunni aldrei breytt milli sumars og vetrar. Þegar hún er 12 á hádegi í Reykjavík í júlí, hvað er hún þá í London?
gloss: Iceland never changes its clocks. At noon in Reykjavík in July, what time is it in London? — 13: both are on GMT in winter, but the UK is on summer time (UTC+1) in July.

text: Prentlistin breytti Evrópu. Hvað af þessu gerðist fyrst?
gloss: Printing changed Europe. Which of these happened first? — Gutenberg's Bible (c. 1455), before Columbus (1492), Luther's 95 theses (1517) and the Guðbrandur Bible (1584).

text: Vilhjálmur Einarsson vann fyrstu ólympíuverðlaun Íslendinga, silfur í Melbourne 1956. Í hvaða grein?
gloss: Vilhjálmur Einarsson won Iceland's first Olympic medal, silver in Melbourne 1956. In which event? — The triple jump.

text: Jón Ögmundarson Hólabiskup er sagður hafa lagt niður heiðin nöfn vikudaga. Hvaða dagur hét áður óðinsdagur?
gloss: Bishop Jón Ögmundarson of Hólar is said to have abolished the heathen weekday names. Which day was once Odin's day? — Wednesday (cf. English 'Woden's day'); Tuesday was Týr's, Thursday Thor's, Friday Frigg's/Freyja's.

text: Hvaða atburður í sögu Íslands átti sér stað árið MCMXLIV?
gloss: Which event in Icelandic history took place in MCMXLIV? — The founding of the republic: MCMXLIV = 1944. Home rule was 1904, sovereignty 1918, the Ring Road opened 1974.

text: Hver var fyrsta teiknimynd Disney í fullri lengd, frumsýnd 1937?
gloss: What was Disney's first full-length animated feature, released in 1937? — Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs; Pinocchio and Fantasia followed in 1940, Bambi in 1942.

text: Hvaða málmur hefur hæst bræðslumark allra málma og var því notaður í glóþræði ljósapera?
gloss: Which metal has the highest melting point of all metals, hence its use in light-bulb filaments? — Tungsten (wolfram), about 3,422 °C.

text: Hvar vestan Grænlands hafa fundist einu óumdeildu minjarnar um búðir norrænna manna frá því um árið 1000?
gloss: Where west of Greenland is the only undisputed Norse site from around the year 1000? — L'Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland (excavated in the 1960s). The Kensington runestone and Newport Tower are famous false claims.

text: Orðið „sími“ var endurvakið úr fornu máli þegar talsíminn kom til landsins. Hvað merkti það upphaflega?
gloss: The word 'sími' was revived from Old Norse when the telephone came to Iceland. What did it originally mean? — Thread or cord: early phones worked over wires.

text: Í Leyndardómum Snæfellsjökuls eftir Jules Verne fara ferðalangarnir niður um gíg jökulsins. Upp um hvaða eldfjall koma þeir aftur?
gloss: In Jules Verne's Journey to the Centre of the Earth the travellers descend through Snæfellsjökull's crater. Up which volcano do they come out? — Stromboli, in Italy.

text: Hvaða hljóðfæri hefur í fullri stærð 47 strengi og sjö pedala sem hækka og lækka tóna?
gloss: Which instrument, full-size, has 47 strings and seven pedals that raise and lower notes? — The concert (pedal) harp.

text: Hvað af þessu telst ekki ber samkvæmt grasafræðinni?
gloss: Which of these is not a berry in the botanical sense? — The strawberry (an aggregate accessory fruit, its seeds on the outside); bananas, tomatoes and grapes are true berries.

text: Hvaða ríki ræður yfir Galápagoseyjum, þar sem Darwin skoðaði finkur og risaskjaldbökur?
gloss: Which country owns the Galápagos Islands, where Darwin studied finches and giant tortoises? — Ecuador.

text: Hvaða forritunarmál dregur nafn sitt af breskum grínþáttum sem BBC hóf að sýna árið 1969?
gloss: Which programming language is named after a British comedy series the BBC began airing in 1969? — Python, after Monty Python's Flying Circus, not the snake.

text: Hvaða reikistjarna ber nafn rómverska guðsins sem Grikkir kölluðu Krónos?
gloss: Which planet bears the name of the Roman god the Greeks called Kronos? — Saturn; Jupiter is Zeus, and Uranus is named after the Greek Ouranos, Kronos's father.

text: Kylfingur leikur holu á „albatrossi“. Á hve mörgum höggum undir pari lék hann hana?
gloss: A golfer makes an 'albatross' on a hole. How many strokes under par? — Three: birdie is one, eagle two, albatross three.
